@@U03117@@
(Sniffing about.)

@@U03118@@
I must say, as I wander among these modest fires, I feel quite the foreigner. They're mostly naked as jaybirds, only here and there do I see a shift. The 斯芬克斯们 are shameless, the griffins downright impudent, and all these winged and curly fleeced things that display themselves fore and aft! I have to admit, of course, that at heart we're as indecent as the next, but this antique style I find a bit too intense. It needs mastering, reforming, in the modern style, to reflect the new sensibility, a bit of plaster here and there, if you know what I mean. What a repulsive lot! But I mustn't let it get the better of me. I'll greet them courteously; after all, I’m a guest. Greetings, fair ladies! And greetings to you, wise old grayfins!

@@U03120@@
(Snarling.)

@@U03121@@
Grayfins! Not grayfins! Griffins! Ah! How dare you call anyone gray! A word's sound tells you its origin. Gray, grouchy, grim, gruesome, grating, grave, groaning. Etymologically they all agree, it’s just that we don’t agree with them.
translation:
@@U03117@@
（嗅了嗅。）

@@U03118@@
我必须说，当我在这些不起眼的火堆中漫步时，我感觉自己完全是个外国人。他们大部分都像松鸦一样赤身裸体，只是在某些地方我看到了变化。斯芬克斯人是无耻的，狮鹫是彻头彻尾无礼的，所有这些长着翅膀和卷曲羊毛的东西在船头和船尾展示自己！当然，我不得不承认，我们的内心和其他人一样不雅，但我觉得这种古色古香的风格有点太强烈了。它需要以现代风格进行掌握、改革，以反映新的情感，到处都需要一点灰泥，如果你明白我的意思的话。多么令人厌恶的一批啊！但我不能让它战胜我。我会礼貌地跟他们打招呼；毕竟我是客人。问候，美丽的女士们！向您致意，聪明的老灰鳍鱼！

@@U03120@@
（咆哮。）

@@U03121@@
灰鳍鱼！不是灰鳍鱼！狮鹫！啊!你怎么敢说别人是灰色的！一个词的发音告诉你它的起源。灰色，脾气暴躁，冷酷，可怕，刺耳，严肃，呻吟。从词源学上来说，他们都同意，只是我们不同意他们。
